title: Matambre Arrollado
description: Matambre Arrollado is a dish from Argentina featuring beef flank steak, garlic, chicken egg, carrot. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 65 minutes.
Boil the eggs for about 11 minutes, cool promptly in cold water, peel and prepare as required.
Lay the cooked eggs, softened carrots, bell pepper and olives along the flattened beef to form the filling, then roll tightly before braising.
Fill and wrap the prepared portions in their wrappers or food-safe leaves; close the edges without tearing.
Add the braising liquid and seasonings, cover and cook gently for about 120 minutes until the meat is tender and safely cooked.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 75 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
